description: Base gas price right now: base fee, priority fee p25/p50/p90 over the last 20 blocks, ready-to-sign maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas for slow, normal and fast inclusion, an L1 data-fee upper bound, and the estimated total cost in wei of an ETH transfer and an ERC-20 transfer, read live from Base mainnet RPC with the block number. $0.0015 USDC on Base. Failed read, no charge. No account, no API key. Estimates, not inclusion guarantees. By Ontario Protocol. [PAID: 0.0015 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: a call without payment returns MCP PaymentRequired; the retry carries the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta['x402/payment']. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Signing happens in the caller's wallet.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

blocks.description: Optional number of recent blocks the fee percentiles cover, 5 to 50. Default 20.

name: ontario_base-gas
title: Base Gas Price

x402.not_for: Not an inclusion guarantee or a gas estimate for arbitrary contract calls.
x402.purchase_reason: maxFeePerGas and maxPriorityFeePerGas values, or a cost budget for a Base transfer, from one call.
x402.selection_rule: Returns current Base fee data: next-block base fee, tip percentiles over 20 blocks, slow, normal and fast fee suggestions and L1 data-fee upper bounds. A failed read is not charged.
